about: The email guard's own fixtures (E1): acceptance messages EM1-EM6, the false-positive table EFP1-EFP10, mail-specific ham (legacy charsets, forwarded chains, digests, attachments, sender notes) and mail-specific attacks (subject, sender name, Reply-To, attachment names, calendar descriptions, forwarded and deeply nested messages, structured Graph and Gmail API shapes). Written for this repository; no real mailbox content. Attack payloads are benign markers (LSTEST). {{tags:...}} becomes Unicode tag characters when loaded. Built into messages by src/mail-corpus.ts.
